content: The title of the page should be formatted as (Disease name) historical perspective, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The purpose of this page is to provide a detailed account of the history of the disease or condition, including how it was discovered and the subsequent advancements in its study over time. At the top of the edit box, include the following elements: the {{CMG}} template, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template you created earlier. When creating links within WikiDoc, ensure that key terms are linked to specific pages. For example, if the text mentions anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to the page for anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For further guidance on creating links, click here. This page is not intended to document patient history or the natural history of the disease. Follow the prescribed format and capitalization rules as outlined in the template. Additionally, ensure that the name of the disease is included in the first sentence of every subsection. Overview Section The overview section should begin with the name of the disease in the first sentence and provide a concise description of the key aspects of the information presented throughout the page. For an example of an overview section, click here. Template for Writing First Sentence: Examples: The disease was first discovered by [scientist] in [year]. The condition was initially identified during [specific event or time period]. Additional Sentences: Examples: Diagnostic techniques for the disease were developed by [scientist] in [year]. There have been several notable outbreaks of the disease, which are summarized below. The association between [factor] and [disease] was first established in [year]. In [year], [scientist] was the first to discover the link between [factor] and the development of [disease]. In [year], mutations in [gene] were first implicated in the pathogenesis of [disease]. The following are a few famous cases of [disease]. Discovery Section This section should detail how the disease was initially discovered, including the time of discovery and the individual(s) responsible for the discovery. For an example of a discovery section, click here. Landmark Events in the Development of Treatment Strategies This section should include: Notable scientists who contributed to the study of the disease. Significant changes in approaches to studying the disease. Visual representations of treatments, such as the iron lung for polio. For guidance on adding images, click here. For an example of this section, click here. Impact on Cultural History This section should explore the cultural impact of the disease over time, including: Pandemics, epidemics, and outbreaks, as well as initial mortality rates. The societal effects of the disease, such as the devastation it caused, how affected individuals were treated, and the impact of treatments used at the time. For an example of this section, click here. Famous Cases This section should highlight prominent historical cases of the disease, including: Well-known individuals who were afflicted by the condition. Famous cases that helped define the disease in history, such as Typhoid Mary.
